_tooltips.id: Unique within your organization; every placement of the widget refers to it. Lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens, e.g. cards-grid; it cannot be changed once pages use the widget.
_tooltips.name: The widget's name as designers see it in the palette, e.g. Cards grid.
_tooltips.translocoId: Optional translation key; when set, it is shown instead of the Name in other languages, e.g. cards_grid.name.
_tooltips.category: The group the widget is listed under in the palette, e.g. Content, Data or Navigation. Free text; widgets with the same category are shown together.
_tooltips.icon: Name of the Material icon shown next to the widget in the palette, e.g. grid_view.
_tooltips.description: What the widget does, as a note for you and your fellow designers; users do not see it.
_tooltips.status: DRAFT while the widget has changes that are not published yet, PUBLISHED once the current version is published with the Publish button. Set by the system.
_tooltips.version: Increases with every save. Set by the system.
_tooltips.publishedVersion: The version that was last published; empty until the widget is published for the first time. Set by the system.
_tooltips.updatedAt: When the widget was last saved. Set by the system.
_tooltips.inputPorts: The values the widget receives from the page it is placed on, one row per value, e.g. the list of items a grid shows.
_tooltips.outputPorts: The values the widget passes back to the page, one row per value, e.g. the item a user selected.

_tooltips.name: Identifies the port, unique within the widget, e.g. items. A widget placed on a page is wired to its container by this name.
_tooltips.type: The kind of value the port receives: STRING, NUMBER, BOOLEAN, DATE, OBJECT or ARRAY for plain values, ENTITY_REF for a single record, ENTITY_COLLECTION for a filtered list of records.
_tooltips.description: What the port is for, as a note for the designers who place the widget on a page.
_tooltips.entityType: Only for ENTITY_REF and ENTITY_COLLECTION: the entity type whose records travel through the port, e.g. order. Leave empty for the other types.
_tooltips.attributeVisibility: Only for ENTITY_REF and ENTITY_COLLECTION: which attributes of the records the widget gets by default. Set mode to ALL, INCLUDE or EXCLUDE, and for the latter two list the attributes, e.g. attributes = name, price.
_tooltips.required: Tick it if the widget cannot work without this value; the page that places the widget must then supply it.
_tooltips.defaultValue: The value the widget uses when the port is optional and the page supplies nothing, e.g. 10.
_tooltips.defaultRsqlFilter: Only for ENTITY_COLLECTION: the filter applied when the page supplies none, written in RSQL, e.g. status==OPEN.

_tooltips.name: Identifies the port, unique within the widget, e.g. selectedItem. A widget placed on a page is wired to its container by this name.
_tooltips.type: The kind of value the port emits: STRING, NUMBER, BOOLEAN, DATE, OBJECT or ARRAY for plain values, ENTITY_REF for a single record, ENTITY_COLLECTION for a filtered list of records.
_tooltips.description: What the port is for, as a note for the designers who place the widget on a page.
_tooltips.entityType: Only for ENTITY_REF and ENTITY_COLLECTION: the entity type whose records travel through the port, e.g. order. Leave empty for the other types.
_tooltips.attributeVisibility: Only for ENTITY_REF and ENTITY_COLLECTION: which attributes of the records the widget passes on. Set mode to ALL, INCLUDE or EXCLUDE, and for the latter two list the attributes, e.g. attributes = name, price.
